description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 1st-level spells, Elemental Focus (Ice)

Benefit: As long as you have an elemental (ice) spell of 1st level or higher in your known spells and have at least 1 MP in your MP pool, you can call forth a weapon made of ice as a move action, dealing additional ice damage equal to the level of the highest-level ice spell you can cast. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (ice) spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 1st-level spells, Elemental Focus (Ice)
